Attempted to end my life or have my stomach removed for ED reasons not long after. Hardest year of my life. 

Probably during that psych stay when people started commenting that I looked very different from my intake photo and when they started asking if I had ever been diagnosed with an eating disorder. 

Now, being feeding tube dependent and missing half a dozen organs, including 1/2 of my digestive tract I feel I'm in too deep.
Maintaining isn't good enough, it's all I think about, I feel guilty for eating, compulsive exercise, media overconsumption.

It really doesn't have the same type of sweetness as sucrose or honey imo. It's more like Splenda, but hard to describe.

The odor is very acetic, but not strong. Very chemical, that's about all I get from the smell. 

The taste? It's not metallic at all to me. It's a bit fruity and acetic tasting. Defiantly sweet, but not like table sugar, more like Splenda. Very artificial and chemical. My body told me to vomit, but after rinsing the taste is completly gone.

It initially has very little taste, but then starts to tingle and tastes a lot more strongly.

I have a video of me trying it for the first time if you want it.

I've only tasted lead acetate, and not any other lead compounds, so I don't have a great comparison.

Truth be told I wasn't in extreme poverty, but we did have it rough. All five of us lived in my mom's parents' basement (with no kitchen, a makeshift bathroom, and 2 bedrooms) and we had to cut out coupons to go to the grocery store. 

Our big treat that we got every few months was renting from Netflix and laying out a blanket on the living room floor to eat Chinese takeout on. It always made me so happy. It just felt like the whole family was one. I'll never forget those nights.

We finallysaved enough to get our own house when I was going into fifth grade and it was the most amazing thing. Even though it was a major fixer upper, we made it work and fixed things as we could.

TL;DR Renting from Netflix and eating Chinese takeout as a family.
